scenario.topic: Pick the menu concept for the office's international food day

options.name: Global Street Food Festival
options.upside: Offers a casual, diverse selection of popular street foods from multiple countries.
options.concern: May have limited seating space due to buffet setup and informal dining.

options.name: Traditional Family Feast
options.upside: Features authentic, home-style dishes with a warm, sit-down dining experience.
options.concern: Fewer countries represented and lacks gluten-free options.

options.name: Fusion Tapas Selection
options.upside: Provides a creative mix of international flavors in small, shareable portions.
options.concern: Portion sizes may not satisfy those preferring traditional meal formats.

options.name: International Vegan Buffet
options.upside: Covers a wide range of countries with fully vegan dishes suitable for most diets.
options.concern: May not appeal to participants seeking meat-based options.

shared_context: The office is organizing an international food day to celebrate diverse cuisines. Six participants will choose one menu concept that offers a variety of dishes representing different countries and accommodates common dietary preferences.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a 34-year-old project manager who enjoys traditional and authentic dining experiences.
personas.private_goal: She wants a menu that feels homey and comforting with familiar, sit-down meals.

A.reason_for: Offers diverse countries and includes vegetarian and gluten-free options.
A.reason_against: Buffet style feels too informal and may lack the warm dining experience Maya prefers.

B.reason_for: Authentic home-style dishes with a warm, sit-down dining experience that Maya values.

C.reason_for: Includes vegetarian and gluten-free options with a creative international mix.
C.reason_against: Small plates may not feel like a full meal.

D.reason_for: Wide range of countries and fully vegan dishes which are healthy and inclusive.
D.reason_against: Lacks meat options, which Maya prefers.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a 29-year-old software developer who enjoys trying creative and shareable dishes.
personas.private_goal: He wants a menu that encourages socializing and tasting many flavors in small portions.

A.reason_for: Casual and diverse street foods from multiple countries, good for socializing.

B.reason_for: Authentic dishes are nice but fewer countries and no gluten-free options limit variety.
B.reason_against: Less creative and no gluten-free options.

C.reason_for: Creative fusion flavors in small, shareable plates that fit Liam’s social dining preference.

D.reason_for: Wide country representation and vegan options are inclusive.
D.reason_against: No meat options may limit appeal.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a 42-year-old HR specialist who values authentic cultural experiences and inclusivity.
personas.private_goal: She wants a menu that feels genuine and accommodates common dietary needs.

A.reason_for: Diverse countries and includes vegetarian and gluten-free options.
A.reason_against: Informal buffet style may feel less authentic than sit-down meals.

B.reason_for: Authentic, home-style dishes with a warm, sit-down experience Nina prefers.

C.reason_for: Creative international flavors and dietary accommodations.
C.reason_against: Small plates may not feel substantial enough.

D.reason_for: Wide range of countries and fully vegan dishes are inclusive and healthy.
D.reason_against: No meat options might reduce appeal for some.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a 38-year-old marketing specialist who enjoys casual, diverse food experiences.
personas.private_goal: He wants a menu that offers many countries and dietary options in a relaxed setting.

A.reason_for: Offers casual, diverse street foods from multiple countries and includes vegetarian and gluten-free options.

B.reason_for: Authentic dishes but fewer countries and no gluten-free options reduce appeal.

C.reason_for: Creative international flavors with dietary accommodations.
C.reason_against: Small plates may not satisfy all.

D.reason_for: Wide country range and vegan options are inclusive.
D.reason_against: No meat options might not appeal to everyone.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a 27-year-old graphic designer who prefers direct and efficient dining with variety.
personas.private_goal: She wants a menu that balances variety and convenience with familiar flavors.

A.reason_for: Diverse countries, vegetarian and gluten-free options, and casual buffet style suits Zoe’s preference.

B.reason_for: Authentic but fewer countries and no gluten-free options make it less appealing.
B.reason_against: More formal and limited dietary accommodations.

C.reason_for: Creative, shareable plates with good dietary options.
C.reason_against: Small portions may not satisfy everyone.

D.reason_for: Wide country range and vegan options are healthy and inclusive.
D.reason_against: No meat options may reduce appeal.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a 45-year-old data analyst who enjoys detailed discussion and thoughtful choices.
personas.private_goal: He wants a menu that offers variety and accommodates dietary needs without sacrificing quality.

A.reason_for: Good variety of countries and dietary options in a casual buffet style.
A.reason_against: Informal dining might not suit everyone.

B.reason_for: Authentic dishes but fewer countries and no gluten-free options limit inclusivity.

C.reason_for: Creative international flavors, vegetarian and gluten-free options, and shareable plates.

D.reason_for: Wide country coverage and fully vegan dishes are inclusive and healthy.
D.reason_against: No meat options could limit appeal.
